captions.detailed: A 3D-printable, U-shaped bed clamp designed with sharp geometric features. It has a central rectangular cutout to slide over the edge of a print bed and glass plate, with two thick clamping arms extending outward. The outer corners of the clamp feature triangular ridges and stepped profiles to increase structural rigidity, while the inner clamping tips have small protruding nubs that provide a tighter grip.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric U-shaped glass bed clamp in OpenSCAD. The script should allow customization of the print bed thickness, glass plate thickness, clamp width, bar thickness, extension depth, and a tensioning nub size to ensure a snug fit.
captions.factory: The script uses a union of three main parts. The main U-shaped body is created by subtracting a smaller rectangular cube from a larger base cube, followed by an inner corner relief subtraction using cylinders and cubes to prevent stress concentrations. Two clamping nubs are added to the tips of the arms using cylinders intersected with cubes to form half-cylindrical profiles, adjusted by the 'nub' variable.
